newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds ended lower in lacklustre trade on Monday with dealers expecting no action at tomorrow's Bank of Spain repo auction.
A Reuter poll of 10 financial experts said no change was expected in the key money market rate which currently stands at six percent.
As a result the yield curve flattened, with the two to 10- year spread narrowing to 122 basis points from 123 at the start.
With very little domestic news, long term yields tracked other European markets, with the 10-year spread over Bunds ending a little lower at 118 basis points from 120 bps.
But dealers added a more stable peseta should lend some support to the short end of the curve, which could steepen in the coming days after Tuesday's repo. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
